headline: Attero Plans ₹3,000 Crore Battery Metal Extraction and Recycling Push in India
summary: Indian recycling firm Attero announced a ₹3,000 crore expansion plan focusing on lithium, nickel, and cobalt extraction, alongside building battery recycling facilities in Bengaluru and Andhra Pradesh.
why: Battery recycling is vital for securing critical raw materials for electric vehicles and renewable energy storage.

impacts.name: Attero Recycling
impacts.why: A 3,000 crore rupee capital investment expands critical battery recycling capacity.
